scope: Player heat/exposure semantics, clothing radiation transfer, food bounds, heater feedback, equipment weight, thermal illness and attribute operations
fixes: Radiation is integrated as power; no power/conductance equilibrium temperature reaches direct injury
Clothing insulation limits incoming radiation as well as passive environmental exchange
Food cannot reverse its heat direction or clamp a pre-existing out-of-range part with zero energy
Heater vest uses signed feedback and stops replacing cooling of an already overheated body
First equipment weight effect checks the existing instance before reading it
Temperature-owned hot/cold illness follows actual torso temperature level, sign and recovery
Severe exposure hit frequency uses real elapsed seconds and clothing transmission
Clothing MULTIPLY_BASE aggregation follows vanilla operation semantics

Food positive, negative, zero and out-of-range directionality
Thermal illness escalation, hot/cold reversal and recovery
Heater vest feedback and fractional final heating-pad resource interval
Current body energy save/load and intentional old-body reset

No full legacy survival/death/recovery/resource calibration or hundred-player qualification
Real campfire test validates the reported 12 C plus radiation chain, not a replay of the user's exact enclosed room
Existing optional-mod missing recipe and resource duplication warnings remain in the stripped GameTest environment
